alex (Eng): Quick Q  I'm moving from Denver, CO to Portland, OR on 2026-06-01. Does the $60 WFH stipend transfer or get suspended when I change my address? Also anything about benefits network changes?
nina (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: Stipend follows the Work Location field in HRIS, so it continues as long as you remain "remote". If you change to a different eligibility category (e.g., "onsite") it could stop.
alex (Eng): I'll stay remote. Do I need to upload proof right away?
hris-bot: Please upload proof of new address (lease/utility/ID) under Profile > Documents to avoid delays. Update before the payroll cutoff (20th 11:59pm MT) to get proration for June if move is mid-month.
mike (Payroll): Practical: if change is effective in HRIS on or before the cutoff we prorate that month's stipend. Proration formula: (active days that month / total days) * $60, rounded to nearest dollar. Also OR has no state income tax, so your state withholding will change accordingly once processed.
nina (People Ops): Also note: moving states can be a benefits qualifying life event for some carriers; DM me and I'll share carrier steps if you want to change plans mid-year. No company-level tax nexus impact from a single employee move.
alex (Eng): Thanks 44d I updated my address and uploaded the lease.
hris-bot: Ticket #HRIS-2026-441 opened to sync address change to payroll and benefits. Estimated 48 hours.
mike (Payroll): I'll monitor and post back here when withholding and stipend were updated.
